title: $D$-bialgebras, dendrification and embeddings into AWB of almost Poisson algebras
summary: An algebra with bracket ({\sf AWB} for short) is an associative algebra endowed with a bilinear bracket satisfying a Leibniz-type compatibility condition, as introduced in \cite{casas}. It can be viewed as a noncommutative generalization of an almost Poisson algebra; indeed, when the associative product is commutative and the bracket is skew-symmetric, one recovers the notion of an almost Poisson algebra.
